description: palate — SessionStart injects the current prewarm block (session-scope preferences, ~500 tok) and, cross-session, replays any model_edits.json state left from a prior run; when an LLM gateway is configured it also fires a detached, lock-guarded distiller pass over the just-closed transcript. UserPromptSubmit first walks model_edits.json — a snapshot that drifted from disk since Stop can only be a hand-edit, so it is learned as user_diff (w=0.6) and cleared — then captures an "I prefer …" clause as a STATED preference (behind the same secret/injection scanner as the CLI) and, on an intent shift, injects a goal-scope prewarm block (~200 tok). PostToolUse (Edit|Write) snapshots the edited file (hash + 4KB bound) so a later hand-edit can be diffed. Stop re-baselines every snapshot to disk (the assistant still owns the turn, so drift here is its own sed/python edit, never the user's) and — with an LLM gateway configured — fires the same detached distiller pass. PreCompact writes a recovery prewarm block to .palate/recovery.md. Every handler degrades to empty output on error; hooks never fail the session.
